response.body:
## OpenShell v0.1.5

### Quick install

```bash
curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | OPENSHELL_VERSION=v0.1.5 sh
```

### Upgrade notes

- Supervisor OCSF log files are now named `openshell-ocsf.YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` instead of `.log`, so update any collector patterns from `openshell-ocsf.*.log` to `openshell-ocsf.*.jsonl`. Old `.log` files are not migrated and may be cleaned up, so collect any history you need before upgrading. [#4263](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4263)
- On Kubernetes, sandbox templates that set pod annotations or labels are now rejected unless an operator allowlists those keys with the new `allowed_pod_annotations` and `allowed_pod_labels` settings in `[openshell.drivers.kubernetes]`. This affects direct API or SDK callers that set `SandboxTemplate.labels` or `SandboxTemplate.annotations`, including recovery of timed-out sandboxes; the `openshell` CLI and `--label` metadata labels are unaffected. [#4497](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4497)
- The gateway now rejects annotation keys with the reserved `internal.openshell.ai/` prefix on `CreateSandbox` and `UpdateConfig`. [#4626](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4626)
- The Go SDK's `SandboxInterface.Create()` and `CreateFromTemplate()` now take functional options such as `WithLabels()`, `WithAnnotations()`, and `WithServiceExposures()` instead of a positional labels argument and the removed `CreateOptions` struct. Update call sites to the new options. [#3198](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3198)
- External compute drivers that provision `openshell-sandbox` must update their bootstrap descriptor from `outer_fence` to `provisioning_evidence`; drivers that use their own isolation backend are unaffected. This release also publishes the versioned Sandbox Protocol for independently implemented backends. [#3898](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3898)
- The snap no longer enables the user gateway service for every user; the install script enables it only for the user who ran it. After a direct snap install, or if an older snap revision enabled it globally, run `sudo systemctl disable --global snap.openshell.user-gateway.service` once and then `systemctl --user enable --now snap.openshell.user-gateway.service` from the single account that should run the gateway. [#4615](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4615)

### Bug fixes

- Hostname-based network policy is now bound to supervisor-controlled DNS, while sandbox host aliases still require explicit IP validation or a trusted gateway pin. [#4602](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4602)
- Stopping a MicroVM sandbox no longer discards recent writes, because the guest now flushes its filesystem before shutdown. [#4195](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4195)
- You can now stop a sandbox stuck in `Error` after a startup failure and start it again, without deleting it or its persistent workspace. [#4231](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4231)
- OTLP export with gzip compression or an `https://` endpoint no longer fails at startup. [#4399](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4399)
- Podman deployments can trust a private CA for inspected HTTPS egress with the new `additional_ca_bundle` setting, without rebuilding the supervisor image. The CA is trusted for all destinations by both the supervisor and the workload. [#3996](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3996)
- The Helm chart now installs in namespaces that enforce the Restricted Pod Security standard, and the certgen hook security context can be overridden with `pkiInitJob.securityContext`. [#3340](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3340)
- GitHub App OAuth token refresh now works, because the gateway asks for a JSON response. [#4530](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4530)
- A deleted provider that sandboxes still reference no longer blocks gateway startup; the gateway logs a warning instead. [#4661](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4661)
- In Kubernetes operator workspace mode, labeled workspaces are no longer rejected with `PermissionDenied` right after gateway startup. [#4527](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4527)
- Kubernetes PVC mounts can no longer overlap driver-managed runtime and control paths. [#4522](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4522)
- The sandbox network broker now denies operations when it cannot verify a descriptor, instead of falling back to native handling. [#4494](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4494)
- VM guest startup is hardened so the packaged sandbox keeps its expected executable identity. [#4539](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4539)
- Seccomp notification probe failures now report the actual kernel error instead of a generic "notification launcher disappeared" message. [#4051](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4051)
- e2fsprogs preflight checks no longer fail when Linux briefly reports a newly installed executable as busy. [#4315](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4315)
- Middleware now sees `http` and `ws` for plaintext requests in a tunnel instead of `https` and `wss`. [#4397](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4397)
- L7 OCSF HTTP events now report `https` for TLS-terminated requests. [#4684](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4684)
- OCSF events now include the required `device.os.type_id`, so they validate against the OCSF 1.8 schema. [#4677](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4677)
- Mutation-lock metrics from the gateway's startup reconciliation are no longer dropped. [#4524](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4524)
- Updated `rustls` to 0.23.46 to address RUSTSEC-2026-0346 through RUSTSEC-2026-0349. [#4568](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4568)
- The RPM-installed Python SDK now imports correctly, and its stubs can be generated with older `protoc` versions. [#4439](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4439)
- Builds now honor the `PROTOC` environment variable, so distribution builds can use their system protobuf compiler. [#4441](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4441)

### Features

- Supervisors can now receive configuration changes pushed over their gateway session by setting `config_delivery_mode = "push"`, so policy and setting changes reach sandboxes in about 100 ms instead of up to 10 seconds. Polling remains the default in this release. [#4320](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4320)
- The gateway and sandbox supervisors can export OCSF events as OTLP log records when `[openshell.gateway.otlp.ocsf]` sets `enabled = true`, and you can now send traces and OCSF events to different OTLP endpoints. Existing configurations with only `[openshell.gateway.otlp] endpoint` behave as before. [#4500](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4500), [#4545](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4545)
- The gateway now emits OCSF Authentication events for rejected requests, including the authentication mechanism, a reason category, the peer address, and the request ID. [#4632](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4632), [#4655](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4655), [#4673](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4673)
- MicroVM sandboxes can mount host directories through virtiofs after an operator sets `enable_bind_mounts = true` in `[openshell.drivers.vm]`. You can use up to 3 mounts on x86_64 or 32 on aarch64, and QEMU-backed and GPU launches do not support mounts. [#3463](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3463)
- The Docker supervisor can now use bridge networking with the new `supervisor_network_mode` setting; host networking remains the default. [#4016](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4016)
- `openshell sandbox create` now accepts repeatable `--annotation KEY=VALUE` flags. [#4325](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4325)
- `openshell sandbox create` adds `--env-from KEY[=ENVVAR]` to set sandbox environment variables from the CLI's environment without putting values on the command line. The `OPENSHELL_OCSF_JSON=1` gateway audit sink is also now available on all platforms. [#4106](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4106)
- When a dynamic token grant is refused, sandbox reads now show a bounded cause and recovery action, while the workload gets an HTTP 502 with an `x-openshell-request-id` it can share. [#4427](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4427)
- The Helm chart adds `server.dataStorageSize` and `server.dataStorageClass` to configure the gateway data PVC. [#3854](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3854)
- Gateway mutation locks are now scoped per workspace and sandbox, with bounded waits, so bursts of supervisor reconnects no longer queue behind a single fleet-wide lock. [#4147](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4147)

### Other

- Added documentation for the Port Forwarding IPv6 loopback example, `sandbox create` size limits, Kubernetes managed workspace setup, and new Observability overview and Traces pages. [#2449](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/2449), [#4447](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4447), [#4622](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4622), [#4560](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4560)
- Removed the grpcurl walkthrough from the README. [#4585](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4585)
- Added an RFC that proposes a sandbox service exposure architecture. [#4267](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4267)
- Introduced a backend-neutral cryptography interface while keeping AWS-LC as the production backend and preserving existing credential formats and TLS defaults. [#3351](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3351)
- The CLI and gateway no longer link `ring` alongside AWS-LC. [#4468](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4468)
- Sped up gateway server builds by removing `async_trait` from internal traits. [#4619](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4619)
- Updated development and build dependencies, including setuptools, pytest, TypeScript SDK test dependencies, and GitHub Actions, and temporarily accepted build-only `zip` advisories. [#4711](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4711), [#4713](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4713), [#4712](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4712), [#4710](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4710), [#2625](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/2625), [#3002](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3002), [#4552](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4552)
- Reworked the release pipeline to separate prerelease publication from qualification, promote qualified prereleases to stable, generate PR-based release notes, retry Helm chart pushes, and improve Slack notifications. [#4419](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4419), [#4420](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4420), [#4611](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4611), [#4654](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4654), [#4747](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4747), [#4578](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4578), [#4605](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4605), [#4719](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4719)
- Improved CI reliability and coverage, including restored default E2E coverage, Kubernetes conformance readiness, paginated required-gate lookups, Determinate Nix setup, and stricter compatibility-review risk acceptance. [#4424](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4424), [#4676](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4676), [#4663](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4663), [#4593](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4593), [#4601](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4601), [#4595](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4595)
- Added and stabilized tests for OCI image identities, Landlock descriptor limits, CLI port forwarding, and Kubernetes 1.29 conformance. [#4521](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4521), [#4457](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4457), [#4570](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4570), [#4463](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4463)
- tmachine can now build local Debian and RPM artifacts from a checkout. [#4598](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4598), [#4651](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4651)
- Updated contributor tooling with triage duty workflows, explicit frozen labels for stale issues, and earlier Gator sandbox name validation. [#3082](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/3082), [#4534](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4534), [#4660](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/4660)

response.body:
**v0.0.37 is a breaking release** with major updates to the gateway, entity model, and sandbox scheduling.

Gateway persistence now uses a shared entity schema with Kubernetes-style metadata and labels, and policy revisions plus draft policy recommendations now live in that object model instead of dedicated policy tables. This also changes public protobuf shapes for core resources like sandboxes, providers, and SSH sessions, so existing clients and gateway will need recreation.

On the runtime side, [RFC-0001](https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/blob/main/rfc/0001-core-architecture/README.md) is now substantially implemented with pluggable compute drivers for Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, and experimental MicroVM-backed sandboxes.

This release also introduces an experimental Helm chart for Kubernetes and OpenShift deployments.

Also new in this release: initial provider profiles and sandbox-provider attach lifecycle, OIDC/RBAC gateway auth, GraphQL L7 policy inspection, Kubernetes user namespace support, and expanded Debian/RPM/Homebrew packaging.

### Quick install

```bash
curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | OPENSHELL_VERSION=v0.0.37 sh
```

### Upgrading from v0.0.36 or earlier

v0.0.37 is not compatible with existing gateway state from earlier releases. `openshell start|stop|destroy` commands have been removed. Starting in v0.0.37 the gateway service is now managed as a proper system service setup by the system's package manager.

Before upgrading, back up anything you need from existing sandboxes. Then clean up the old runtime before installing v0.0.37:

```shell
openshell sandbox delete --all

openshell gateway destroy
```

`openshell gateway destroy` must be run before upgrading, while you still have the v0.0.36 or earlier CLI installed. In v0.0.37, gateway lifecycle is no longer managed by the openshell gateway start|stop|destroy commands. Once you have destroyed the gateway, you can delete the `openshell` binary on your path.

After cleanup, reinstall OpenShell using the current installation instructions:

https://docs.nvidia.com/openshell/latest/about/installation

After reinstalling, recreate your sandboxes and re-register or reconfigure any providers, policies, and gateway settings you still need.

* fix(driver-vm): preflight supervisor cross-compile toolchain in start.sh by @pimlock in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/931
* fix(ci): E2E gate must verify work actually ran, not just top-level success by @pimlock in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/926
* fix(ci): bump ci-image tooling versions to clear vendored CVEs by @johntmyers in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/929

* fix(skills): remove --assignee @me from gh pr/issue create commands by @sjenning in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/937
* chore(mise): replace deprecated ubi: prefix by github: prefix by @benoitf in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/923
* fix(ci): rename mise --no-prepare to --no-deps by @pimlock in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/942
* feat(server): add Prometheus metrics infrastructure and gRPC/HTTP request metrics by @sjenning in https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/pull/920
